title: Einstein Phoenix Vortex
description: A surreal painting featuring Albert Einstein's face merging with a vibrant phoenix bird inside a large purple oval frame. A solitary black silhouette of a person stands on a feather at the center of a swirling green and blue vortex, surrounded by floating geometric shapes, circles, and colorful drips against a gradient background.
prompt: Surreal symbolic painting of Albert Einstein's face blending into a fiery colorful phoenix on the right side, both contained within a large purple oval frame. A lone black silhouette stands on a large feather in the center of a swirling turquoise vortex. Scattered floating triangles, circles, and rectangles in blue, orange and yellow. Vibrant drips and fluid color transitions from purple at the top to orange at the bottom in a dynamic psychedelic composition.
